hypothesis: Integer-only fixed-point inference for a supervised native probe scorer, fed public factual eight-address evidence, eliminates platform-dependent probe tie behavior and establishes auditable exact Linux/Windows FIT/VALID decision parity before any new scientific first-use. This is a portability engineering qualification, not a scientific improvement.

source.fixed_public_features: native probe history counts, observed signed feedback, queried candidate address and publicly shown phase; no private law mask/answer/query before support.

portable_inference.fixed_point_weight_quantization: np.rint(w*384), convert to little-endian signed int64 with declared layer order, no float inference after conversion
portable_inference.bias_and_features: bias rounded to same Q; public normalized count and signed outcome features exactly integer multiples of Q/6=64, phase in {0,384}
portable_inference.nonlinearity: integer hard-swish after each hidden layer: x*clip(x+2Q,0,4Q)/(4Q), signed-nearest integer division; replaces floating point GELU ONLY at validation/inference, not original R111 training
portable_inference.linear: quantized integer matmul; symmetric round to nearest integer, unsigned denominator Q; int64 accumulators
portable_inference.decision: choose larger integer score; on equal integer score choose first publicly offered address; no private tie labels or floating epsilon
portable_inference.training: Use R111 native 737-param scorer trained anew on FIT-only public histories, exactly 512 AdamW steps per seed. Do not train on VALID, UNIT_UNSEEN, protected or original R111 weights.
portable_inference.original_float_comparator: R111 original freshly trained same-seed native policy on UNIT_VALID only, for descriptive fidelity, not scientific qualification
portable_inference.hash: SHA256 canonical packed layer signed little-endian int64 quantized weights and biases, order locked, plus SHA256 full active FIT/VALID chosen-action signature per seed

frozen_preconditions: all native models train 512 FIT only
all quantized state tensors signed integer Q=384
quantized scorer uses integer operations only after source read
no floating score threshold at decision
same public offer/physical probe budget for original and new variants
evaluation.preferred_follow_up: Only after exact portable inference parity passes, freeze a new genuinely structured unfamiliar causal dependency hypothesis with new protected-independent seeds/heldouts. Do not rerun R111 spent cohort, claim native model acceptance or conflate active synthetic action with real scientific discovery.
